name: AI Arrest Trend: Make the “Getting Arrested Again” Video With One Photo
blurb: The AI arrest trend turns one photo into a shaky phone video of a fake arrest: two officers walk you out at night, hands cuffed behind your back, red and blue lights flashing, and you give the camera a small, smug smile.

prompts.label: 1. Open [AI Photo with this template](https://www.makeviral.ai/photo?template=ai-arrest-trend) and add your photo (your own photo). The photo prompt is filled in
prompts.text: Use the uploaded image as the base. Keep the person's face, facial features, skin tone, hair, body shape and original clothing exactly the same as in the photo. A photorealistic vertical 9:16 still from a handheld smartphone video of a fictional night-time movie arrest scene on an urban night street of brick houses. The person has just been walked out of the front door of a house onto the pavement, hands cuffed behind the back, escorted by two uniformed officers, one on each side, each holding one of the person's arms just above the elbow. The officers wear plain dark navy uniforms with no badges, no patches and no writing. The person looks straight into the camera with a restrained, knowing smile. Behind them a plain white patrol car at the curb flashes red and blue roof lights that tint the faces and the house walls. Shot by a bystander a few steps in front of them at chest height, framing the three from the knees up, with slight phone-camera grain and a soft background. Exactly three people: the person in the middle and the two officers. No badges, no shoulder patches, no department names, no readable text on the uniforms or the car, no captions, no logos, no watermark.
